title: Cover remaining scan projection cut proof fences with deterministic mutation witnesses
outcome: Regression witnesses distinguish remaining projection-cut input classes at the preparation-to-commit boundary.
acceptance: Table-driven or equivalent deterministic hook cases cover carried-check hazards, registration and compaction proof markers, retained-row/presence/lifecycle changes and project/session-child or index drift.
Each relevant mutation demonstrates live fallback and verifies its published summary or delta; existing unchanged-input and unrelated-history controls remain intact.
